title: Equilibrium Lending — deregistered Substrate chain + empty, admin-gated Ethereum ChainBridge
closed_reasons: Equilibrium parachain 2011 is Deregistered on Polkadot and every public RPC/WSS endpoint is dead — no transaction can reach the Substrate lending state; funds are stuck (S), not extractable
Ethereum ChainBridge v2 (0x267c4d894db79a3023e266B84401e58f7434e1F1) + ERC20 handler (0xe2a1D7C0c2ED4d3937bd6f93d9aCeA7498232F2F) hold 0 of all 9 registered tokens and 0 ETH
adminWithdraw / transferFunds / deposit-enable paths revert 'sender doesn't have admin role' for arbitrary callers; admin = team EOA 0x81925a13D326420baEFD9f0b51bDd6309f778637
executeProposal / voteProposal revert 'sender doesn't have relayer role' for arbitrary callers (2-of-5 relayer quorum)

Bridge deposits to Equilibrium (chain 7) and chains 0/2/3 are disabled ('deposits resource to chain with supplied chainID are disabled'); chain 1 (Genshiro) deposits remain enabled but are inbound-only (no extraction)
ChainBridge v1 (0x13D3D12478044E6Ea1b76F2A52d4bb6Dd3Ec867F) is paused since 2022-09-05 and its handlers hold 0
EQ mint is MINTER_ROLE-gated to the bridge handler only (mintable only through 2-of-5 relayer proposals); EQ/EQD/GENS have no market price — economic value 0
The handler float was already swept by the team admin on 2025-04-08 (~$96k) — privileged (P), not unprivileged
key_facts: Polkadot parachain 2011 status: Deregistered (first_period=14, last_period=14); DefiLlama deadFrom 2024-09-01, last TVL 2024-08-21 = $1,134,428.70 (DOT 197,939 + USDC 220,865 + WETH 2.371 + iBTC 0.0464 + alts)
Mark-to-market of that frozen basket at 2026-10-03 prices = $472,910.82 (DOT $1.2101, ETH $2,680.73, BTC $84,821.07)
All Equilibrium/Genshiro RPC endpoints dead (node.equilibrium.io, dwellir, onfinality, parity, genshiro endpoints); equilibrium.subscan.io 404; Kong gateway returns 404 'no Route matched'
Equilibrium runtime has no EVM/Frontier pallet — the only EVM contracts are the Ethereum-side ChainBridge deployment
Team EOA 0x81925a13D326420baefd9f0b51bdd6309f778637 created 16 contracts (2021 ChainBridge v1 + GENS/EQD, 2022 ChainBridge v2 + EQ/EQD tokens/proxies); none hold value today

v2 bridge: threshold 2, 5 relayers, paused=false, chainID 0, version '0.1.0', fee 0.001 ETH; 9 registered resources; 52 lifetime deposits (39 Genshiro domain 1, 13 Equilibrium domain 7 EQ Jan-Feb 2024)

eth_call simulations from 0x...dEaD: adminWithdraw -> 'sender doesn't have admin role'; executeProposal/voteProposal -> 'sender doesn't have relayer role'; handler.withdraw -> 'sender must be bridge contract'; EQ.mint -> 'must have minter role to mint'; deposit -> deposits disabled
Even the admin cannot extract: adminWithdraw(handler,USDC,admin,1) reverts 'ERC20: call failed' because the handler balance is 0
v2 bridge resource-list getter 0x5096c417 returns 9 resource IDs (WETH/USDT/DAI/WBTC/USDC/CRV lock-release + EQD/EQ/GENS burn-mint); handler balances are 0 for all 9

Deposits: destination chain 7 (Equilibrium) and chains 0/2/3 are disabled; chain 1 (Genshiro) deposits are still enabled but inbound-only (caller pays 0.001 ETH fee, gets nothing) — Genshiro chain is dead

Independent child re-enumeration: exactly 16 team contracts, no missed deployment; only real-token dust is 19,568.5859 BTT (~$0.007) in the v1 handler, not whitelisted and not withdrawable (reverts 'sender must be bridge contract')
caveats: Substrate-side figure is DefiLlama's last-known snapshot (2024-08-21), not a live read; the chain state is unreachable so the true remaining balance is unverifiable and could be lower (users may have withdrawn during the 2023-24 wind-down)

Handler token lists come from resource IDs observed in deposit events; a registered-but-never-deposited resource cannot be fully excluded, but it could not hold value without deposits and all deposit events are accounted for
Six custom selectors on the v2 bridge are unidentified (4byte misses); the value-moving ones (adminWithdraw 0x780cf004, transferFunds 0x4603ae38, deposit 0x05e2ca17) were identified and simulated
EQ has no price feed (delisted); relayer-gated minting is therefore valued at $0 today and could regain value only if EQ is re-listed
E-U = $0 is proven on-chain for the Ethereum contracts; for the Substrate chain it is a reachability argument (no node accepts transactions), not a state read
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live: the Equilibrium parachain is deregistered with all RPC endpoints dead (last-known $1.13M, ~$473k mark-to-market, stuck = S), and the Ethereum ChainBridge contracts hold zero value with every value path admin/relayer-gated and deposits disabled.
